text:
ryan: heads-up — saw a production spike on mi250 pool for int4 runs. job failed with a kernel lookup miss at seq_len=4096 :eyes:

ryan: log snippet:
```
Error: KernelNotFoundError: attention_mi250_int4_seq4096 not found in kernel_table
  at KernelResolver.lookup (runtime/pack/kernel_resolver.cc:214)
  at InferencePipeline.dispatch (runtime/pipeline.cc:98)
```

megan: ouch. was that a new model rollout or one-off quant config?

ryan: config was model=v2.1-int4 (pinned), autotune disabled for that customer. Only happens when prefix KV hit rate is low (i.e., cold cache) so path goes through full attention kernel.

jordan: can you paste the kernel_table entry for MI250? iirc we probe per-opset+quant+seq_bucket, maybe our seq_bucket edges don't include 4096.

ryan: pasted below — this is the returned table for mi250/int4:
```
["att_seq128","att_seq256","att_seq512","att_seq1024","att_seq2048"]
```

ryan: so 4096 not covered -> runtime falls back to CPU path which explodes latency (p50 48ms -> 240ms). perf-bot telemetry shows kernel_lookup_miss++ for that customer last 2 hrs.

perf-bot: telemetry alert: kernel_lookup_miss (mi250,int4,seq>=2049) rate=27/hr, avg_fallback_latency_ms=238

katie: is this because we didn't include seq bucket 4096 when building the precompiled kernel set? I thought autotuner was supposed to fill holes.

jordan: autotuner only runs for unlocked pools. Dedicated/Reserved customers sometimes have autotune disabled for stability. We need a conditional routing rule: if exact kernel missing, try a sequence-aware compatibility path (e.g., use seq2048 kernel with tiled split) before falling back to CPU.

megan: agreed. short-term: add a soft-route to `mi250-int4-compat` which does tiled-attention on GPU (still slower than native but much better than CPU). long-term: add a nightly probe to detect uncovered seq buckets and trigger kernel build queue.

ryan: quick patch idea (pseudo):
```
if (!kernel_table.has(seq_bucket)) {
  if (compat_policy == "use_tiled_gpu") route = "mi250-int4-compat";
  else route = fallback_cpu;
}
```

megan: can you also add a metric `kernel_compat_route` so we know how often we hit the compat shim? otherwise it will be invisible.

ryan: will add metric + temporary feature flag + unit test. i'll roll a canary in staging and run through these workloads.

jordan: also add a probe to the autotune dispatcher to mark buckets with zero compiled kernels. we've missed a couple of opset upgrades where buckets were skipped.

katie: action items:
- ryan: feature flag + metric + compat route PR (today)
- megan: create kernel-build job for seq4096 + schedule nightly probe (this week)
- jordan: add bucket-zero detection to autotuner (next sprint)

infra-bot: created ticket INF-4521: "mi250 int4 seq4096: compat route & build" assigned to ryan, megan

ryan: ok i'll start the PR. tagging @megan for the build job details. thanks all :thumbsup:
